title: Customer voice decomposition and prioritized patch list
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a working synthesis of recent customer threads (support, CSM notes, roadmap asks) focused on small/medium effort fixes that materially reduce friction for our hosted API and Dedicated onboarding flows. Goal: produce a prioritized list of 'patch' items (low engineering cost, measurable customer impact) + context for product/engineering pre-triage.

How this was built:
- Inputs: Jun-Nov 2026 support queue exports, 6 CSM customer calls (transcripts attached in Confluence link), Slack thread #cs-feedback-2026, a handful of Dedicated onboarding logs.
- Method: decompose each customer narrative to atomic complaint -> root cause hypothesis -> suggested patch -> metrics to measure.
- Heuristic scoring (quick): frequency * severity * closeness-to-buying (0-3 each) -> crude priority score.

Executive summary (top 8 quick wins):
1) Improved error wording for 429/503s during bursty batching (priority score 8). Patch: change messaging in error payloads + add suggested retry/backoff headers. Expected impact: reduce bewildered developer escalations and false negatives in SDKs. Owner: eng-infra (JIRA-1428).
2) Console route-level latency heatmap (priority score 7). Patch: add route snapshot in console for last 24h (same data we already collect per model route, surface in a compact view). Owner: product-console (ticket JIRA-1654).
3) Quick toggle to disable prefix caching per-route (priority score 7). Patch: add on/off in rollout config; default off for Dedicated trial. Impact: solves a handful of customer regressions with dynamic prompt streams. Owner: serving-runtime.
4) Better onboarding checklist for Dedicated (priority score 6). Patch: 5-step checklist and a sample smoke test script for customers + SRE-run verification. Owner: solutions-eng.
5) SDK error docs snippet + code examples for streaming reconnection (priority score 6). Patch: add concrete examples to SDK docs + copy for quick support copy-paste. Owner: devx.
6) Short-term capacity hint in API responses (priority score 5). Patch: include 'approx-capacity: low/ok/high' header based on routing metrics. Owner: platform-engineering.
7) Small prompt template library for finance/legal use-cases (priority score 5). Patch: 8 vetted templates + caution notes (data retention). Owner: product-hosted-api.
8) Restore older model alias for clients during canary mismatch (priority score 5). Patch: enable alias fallback for 7 days post-deploy. Owner: release-engineering.

Selected decomposed examples (atomic rows):
- Example A:
  raw customer voice: "We keep getting 503s when we try to scale spikes — then the SDK retries flood the system and everything grinds to a halt."
  frequency: 12 tickets in last 90 days
  hypothesized root: burst batching + lack of backoff guidance in error payload + SDK aggressive retry defaults
  quick patch: include 'Retry-After' and 'Recommended-Backoff' header in 503/429 + add sample backoff in SDK defaults
  estimated effort: 2 engineer-days + 1 doc-day
  metric to monitor: number of escalations and retry storm incidents (target: -60% within 30 days)
  linked_ticket: JIRA-1428

- Example B:
  raw customer voice: "Our MLP model calls were slower after rolling out the new quantized variant — can't tell if it's noise or regression."
  frequency: 9 flagged incidents during model rollout windows
  hypothesized root: rollout reporting lacks per-variant latency slicing, customers can't correlate model variant -> perf
  quick patch: add per-variant latency table to model rollout UI and API
  estimated effort: 3 engineer-days + UI time
  metric: reduction in rollback requests and RMSE of latency estimates
  linked_ticket: JIRA-1719 (new)

- Example C:
  raw customer voice: "We need to test Private VPC in our staging infra; current docs are vague and some steps depend on internal support."
  frequency: 5 trial customers stuck in onboarding last quarter
  hypothesized root: docs gap + missing smoke scripts + too many required manual tickets
  quick patch: publish a step-by-step staging playbook + one-click smoke-runner script for customers (bash/python) + update KMS checklist
  estimated effort: 1-2 doc-days + 2 eng-days to expose smoke endpoint
  linked_artifacts: confluence link above

Open questions and risk flags:
- Are we comfortable shipping heuristic 'capacity hint' headers that could be misinterpreted by customers? (ask legal/marketing for wording)
- Disabling prefix caching per-route: risk of higher token-costs if misused — need default-off for trials and clear cost implications in console
- Alias fallback window for model variants: need to reconcile with rollback policy and monitoring (ops risk)

Measurement plan (short):
- Each patch must include 1 leading metric (support ticket volume or escalation count) + 1 safety metric (error rate, lat spikes).
- 30/60/90 day check-ins: CS will own signal, product/eng will own implementation metrics.

Proposed next actions (priority order):
- Week 0: Triage sync with eng-infra and devx (assign owners + minimal spec).
- Week 1: Implement error header + SDK sample (JIRA-1428). Quick docs + ship.
- Week 2: Console route heatmap mock + acceptance criteria (JIRA-1654).
- Week 3: Prefix cache toggle spec and backward-compatibility review.
- Onboarding: solutions-eng to draft the Dedicated checklist and run 2 customer dry-runs.

Notes to self / informal bake list:
- Copy/paste snippets to support playbook (Samira doing)
- Slack thread to announce pick-up: #cs-actions -> tag eng leads
- Keep this doc iterative (will move to Confluence once we have final spec)

Appendix: quick data snapshot (last 90 days)
- total relevant tickets reviewed: 84
- tickets that map to 'burst/backoff' theme: 18
- onboarding blockers (Dedicated/Private): 21
- model-rollout/perf confusion: 15

Unresolved micro-decisions:
- exact text for 'Recommended-Backoff' header (exponential? linear?) -> decision deferred to SRE and SDK owners
- whether route-level heatmap should be aggregated by user or by token-type -> product meeting needed

Contact / owner notes:
- Primary owner (coord): Evan Mitchell (cs)
- Eng infra contact: Luis Chen
- DevX contact: Priya Nair
- Solutions eng: Samira Khan

If you pick something to implement, add the ticket to linked_artifacts above and ping me — I'll move the item to Confluence and add acceptance criteria.

-- end --
